verses.html: 29 As soon as Jesus and His companions had left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
verses.text: 29 As soon as Jesus and His companions had left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.

verses.html: 30 Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever, and they promptly told Jesus about her.
verses.text: 30 Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever, and they promptly told Jesus about her.

verses.html: 31 So He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.
verses.text: 31 So He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.

verses.html: 32 That evening, after sunset, people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed,

verses.html: 33 and the whole town gathered at the door.
verses.text: 33 and the whole town gathered at the door.

verses.html: 34 And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons. But He would not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who He was.

verses.html: 29 And immediately, having come out from the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, along with James and John.

verses.html: 30 Now the mother-in-law of Simon was lying down, being sick with a fever, and immediately they speak to him concerning her.

verses.html: 31 And having approached, he raised her up, having taken hold of her hand, and the fever left her, and she was serving them.

verses.html: 32 Now evening having come, after the sun {had} set, they were bringing to him all the ones having sickness and the ones possessed by demons.

verses.html: 29 As soon as {Jesus forced the demon out of the man}, he left the Jewish meeting place. He, along with Simon, Andrew, James, and John, went to Simon and Andrew’s home.

verses.html: 30 Meanwhile, Simon’s mother-in-law was resting in bed because she had a fever. As soon as {Jesus arrived}, the people there told him that she was sick.

verses.html: 31 So, Jesus went to her. He took her hand and helped her stand up. Then, she recovered from the fever and offered Jesus and his disciples some food.

verses.html: 32 When it was late in the evening, people brought to Jesus many men and women who were sick or whom demons controlled.

verses.html: 33 In fact, almost everybody in the town of Capernaum assembled outside the door of {Simon and Andrew’s home}.

verses.html: 34 Jesus cured many people who were sick in many different ways. He also forced demons out of many people. Further, because the demons realized that Jesus was {the Messiah}, he did not allow them to say anything.
